checkin.title: Day 30 Integration Check-in
checkin.intro: At the beginning of this course, I told you that the journey was designed to help you return with four things. On Day 30, record what those four outcomes look like now, in your own words. This is not a test and nothing is scored. Your answers are for your personal reflection and are not monitored in real time.

items.label: One burden I have entrusted to God
items.placeholder: What did you hand over, and what does that look like on an ordinary day?

items.label: One responsible step I have taken
items.placeholder: The action card that became something that happened.

items.label: One person I have involved
items.placeholder: Who now knows, prays, shares the load, or holds you to the rule?

items.label: One sustainable rhythm I am carrying home
items.placeholder: The rhythm you kept, imperfectly, and how often.

items.label: Help I have sought, if Lesson 27 applied
items.placeholder: Write the call made or the appointment booked. If help was not indicated, write 'Not needed at this time.' If it was indicated but not sought, leave this blank; this is where you resume.

items.label: My next deliberate pause
items.placeholder: What, and the date it is booked for.

checkin.reflection_prompt: In one dated paragraph: what has this month been?
checkin.confirm: I have completed my Day 30 review.
checkin.closing: Go on your way, and go with others. Work when it is yours to work. Stop when it is time to stop. The world is held by God, not by you.
checkin.blank_note: A blank line among the four outcomes is not failure; it identifies the place where your next step begins.
checkin.notes: This check-in belongs to the Day 30 stage of Lesson 28 (front matter `final_action` / `final_done`). The lesson's first checkbox (`action_done`) is the Day 1 stage and can be ticked immediately; the course stays open through the month and the final confirmation becomes available on Day 30 (30 days after the Day 1 checkbox, or immediately if the member says the month is complete).
